title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: params, roles, stop/logprobs, response formatting
author: Avery Lin
description: Brings Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions closer to parity with OpenAI semantics. This PR standardizes param handling (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty), adds full support for role-based messages including system/user/assistant roles, implements stop token behavior and streaming stop handling, surfaces per-token logprobs when requested, and improves response formatting to match OpenAI's JSON shape. Motivation: downstream customers expect drop-in compatibility for migration and SDK parity tests. Changes include API translation layer adjustments, schema validation, expanded unit/integration tests, and updated examples. Checklist: 1) API translation and validation implemented, 2) Streaming path updated to handle stop signals and partial logprobs, 3) New tests covering roles and stop semantics, 4) Docs snippets updated for SDK examples, 5) Backwards-compatible by default unless openai_compat flag enabled. Testing: local unit+integration test suite, canary on staging with internal compatibility tests, CI lint/formatter fixes were applied. Backwards compatibility notes: default behavior unchanged unless compatibility mode enabled; operators can toggle via feature flag. Related Linear tasks ENG-9742 and ENG-9801 and an internal incident INC-4216 informed stop-handling edge cases.
